prompt: A photorealistic medium shot, 16:9, of a masked comic presenter on a deliberately cheap homemade set built from flattened cardboard boxes and silver gaffer tape, photographed on a 35mm compact camera with a 28mm lens. Behind him a cardboard bank facade with painted columns sags forward; he braces it with one gloved palm and tears a strip of gaffer tape off the roll with the other hand, mid-repair, shoulders hunched. A black merino balaclava covers his whole head, the face one smooth continuous knitted surface with a soft fuzzy nap and a loose thread at the temple. A large cream-white felt ring is appliquéd around the face with a visible edge stitch, and one small solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside it, on the right side of the frame at two o'clock. Black roll-neck folded over the hood's neck, crumpled black suit jacket, black leather gloves each carrying a thumbnail-sized stitched patch of the same white ring and red triangle on the back. One bare clamp work lamp from frame left throws a hard shadow across the cardboard. Head large and off-centre. Thanks.
